title: Hard to hold onto
text: Hard to hold onto. I like this butter dish, but it is hard to open....the top is smooth and there is nothing to hold onto to open it. It should have a knob on it or at least some grooves on the sides to make it easier to use.

product_metadata.title: Progressive ProKeeper Butter Container
features: The ProKeeper Butter Container has a silicone seal on the base that allows a airtight seal for butter
Designed with a clear cover to easily identify butter amount, and can store butter in and out of the fridge
Includes measurement markings for short and long sticks of butter, up to 8 tablespoons
Sturdy, non-slip base allows for butter use directly from container
description: Keep your butter safe with the Prepworks by Progressive Butter Keeper. It has a clear lid with a silicone seal on the base that creates an air-tight seal that will keep butter fresh longer. It also features measurement markings for both short and long sticks of butter up to 8 Tablespoons. It can be used both in and out of the fridge and is BPA-Free and Dishwasher safe.
